<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font id="TAB1" style="MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt"></font>Filed September 14, 2011</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font id="TAB1" style="MARGIN-LEFT: 36pt"></font>File No. 000-30291</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Dear Ms. Long:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">On behalf of our client, HII Technologies, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &#8220;<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Company</font>&#8221;), we are filing herewith an Amendment No. 1 (the &#8220;<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Amendment</font>&#8221;) to the Company&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form 10 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Commission</font>&#8221;) on September 14, 2011 (the &#8220;<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Registration Statement</font>&#8221;).&#160; The Amendment has been prepared in response to the comments of the staff (the &#8220;<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Staff</font>&#8221;) delivered by way of it letter dated October 11, 2011 (the &#8220;<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Comment Letter</font>&#8221;).&#160; Set forth below are the Company&#8217;s responses to the Staff&#8217;s comments, numbered in a manner to correspond to the order which the Staff&#8217;s comments were delivered. For your convenience, we have included the original comments from the Comment Letter in their entirety:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">General</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 36pt">
<div style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">1.</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Please note that this registration statement will automatically become effective 60 days from September 14, 2011, the date on which it was first filed with the Commission. See Section 1 2(g)(1) of the Exchange Act. Upon effectiveness, you will become subject to the Exchange Act reporting requirements. As a result, you may wish to consider voluntarily withdrawing your registration statement until such time that you have adequately addressed all of our comments.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Response:</font>&#160;&#160;The Staff&#8217;s comment is noted.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div>
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Item 1. Business, page 2</font></font></div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 36pt">
<div style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">2.</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Please provide a more fulsome discussion of your prior operations, products and services, and how they are different from the new business you are trying to develop. In this regard, it appears from existing disclosure that the subsidiaries whose assets and operations you sold in 2008 and 2011 already had operations in oilfield machinery and industrial valve manufacturing. Clarify what oilfield products and services you intend to supply and explain what down hole tools and industry related technologies are. We note that you have included a discussion of the &#8220;Global Oil Field Services&#8221; industry beginning on page 6, but it is unclear where your anticipated products and services fit in to the industry, or which types of companies you expect to compete with.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Response:</font>&#160;&#160;In response to the Staff&#8217;s comment, the disclosure has been revised as requested.</font></div>

<td style="WIDTH: 36pt">

</td>
<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Please elaborate on the circumstances that led you to sell Shumate and Hemiwedge in 2008 and 2011. Please also include an management&#8217;s analysis of these operations and the trends, events and uncertainties that impacted them in MD&amp;A, particularly as it appears that the operations you intend to develop are in the same industry and may be affected by similar trends, events and uncertainties as your former operations.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

</div>

<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Please revise your disclosure under this heading in light of your indication on page 23 that your lease of the Conroe facility was terminated on August 10, 2011.</font></div>

<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Please discuss the specific experience, qualifications, attributes or skills that led you to the conclusion that each member of your board should serve as a director at this time, in light of your business and structure. <div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; TEXT-DECORATION: underline">Involvement in Certain Legal Proceedings, page 25</font></font></div>

</td>
<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Please revise your disclosure to confirm, if true, that other than Mr. Flemming&#8217;s participation with the Excalibur entities and their 2004 and 2005 bankruptcies, none of your directors, nominees for director, or executive officers were involved in any of the legal proceedings described in Item 401(f) of Regulation S-K during the last 10 years. </td>
<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">We note your disclosure that your securities are not currently listed on an exchange or reported on any over the counter quotation service, but that your common stock was quoted on OTCBB until your registration was revoked in February 2011. In view of this disclosure, please provide additional detail as to the reasons for the revocation, explain why you are registering your securities under the Exchange Act at this time, and disclose whether you intend to seek quotation on the OTCBB again.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
